newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end lower as blue chips retreat.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end lower as blue chips retreat.

text.p: Tokyo stocks closed moderately lower on Tuesday, snapping a three-session winning streak, as an earlier rally based on blue-chip shares yielded to profit-taking, brokers said.
The 225-share Nikkei average retreated 172.52 points or 0.84 percent to finish at 20,402.74. September Nikkei futures slipped 180 points to 20,400.
"High-priced blue-chip shares surged, but the range of rising issues did not widen, causing a cautious mood in the market," said Kaoru Ichikawa, a senior trader at Kokusai Securities Co Ltd.
